# polar (yes/no)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:typePolar`](gmeow-typePolar.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/typePolar>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A yes/no question — its answerhood condition is a proposition and its negation; the direct answers are 'yes' and 'no'. The simplest erotetic kind, the natural target of [`gmeow:wondersWhether`](../properties/gmeow-wondersWhether.md).

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:typePolar`](gmeow-typePolar.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md).

### Loaded Question

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inquiry/examples/loaded-question.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inquiry/examples/loaded-question.ttl)

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inquiry/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .



# --- The polar question and the proposition it takes for granted.
ex:stoppedCheating a gmeow:Question ;
    gmeow:questionType gmeow:typePolar ;
    gmeow:presupposes ex:wasCheating ;
    rdfs:label "have you stopped cheating?"@en .
```
